name: Target -Ochiru Shimai-
original_name: ターゲット -堕ちる姉妹-
source:
Takashi is a boss of the student council. This year's school election comes closer. There is another candidate this time, Akari. He feels anxious, and plans to trap her....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090302083907/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008552]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
隆是学生会会长，今年的校内选举日益临近。这一次，他多了一个名叫明里的竞争对手。内心焦虑的他计划设下陷阱对付她…
